dsdv_eng_rr_e.grt: 5_1_grt FAILED GRT-0116 after 30 extra iterations: overflow 235,866 (M2 111,609 / M3 66,285 / M4 49,361 / M5 8,611), avg use 45%, 3 h 13 min; congestion.rpt hot spots 'capacity:0' at (164,254) (164,140) (204,131) (263,176) = over the SRAM column, (96,140) = over ROM col 2.
causes: All 15 macros OBS M1-M4 and MAX_ROUTING_LAYER = M5 (vertical): over a macro there is ZERO horizontal capacity. The floorplan (eng_rr_e_c_place.png) puts the 8 ROMs in two vertical columns at x 17 and 86 and the SRAM stack at x 151-325, so the logic is cut into vertical slivers (x 4-13, 55-82, 125-147, 325-341) that can only talk horizontally ACROSS macros -> impossible; every macro has its pins on its W edge (x=0), so the ROM col at x 17 faces a 13-um sliver at the die edge and the SRAM pins face the ROM column. Not a density problem (GPL util 23%, std area 15.2k um2).
fix: Re-floorplan by rule: (i) no logic region may be reachable only by a horizontal crossing of a macro; (ii) every macro pin edge faces a logic channel that is connected to the main logic region without a macro crossing; (iii) macros abut the E face (0 pins) or each other with no logic sliver E of them. Concretely: SRAM stack (3x 64x512 + 512x128 + 3x 128x256 = 446 um incl. halos) abutting the E core edge, pins W into a >= 30-um vertical channel that opens into N and S pin bands; ROMs as horizontal rows (4 x 38 um) with pin channels, or rotated R180/MY so their pin edges face the same channel; W face pci band + W logic region contiguous. Alternative needing a grant: MAX_ROUTING_LAYER M6 (horizontal over macros) -> COORD/OWNER (M6 pin grants not growth rule). _m5 sibling (HOLD margin 5, same floorplan) is in 5_1_grt and will fail the same way.
